method.002.en: Ten plain claims on how bazifor.me computes a BaZi, feng shui or naming reading: deterministic, rule-cited, true solar time, no generative AI, disputes marked.
method.002.zh: 十条直白的说明：bazifor.me 如何推算八字、风水或起名解读。结果确定、规则有出处、用真太阳时、不用生成式 AI、有争议处会标明。

method.003.en: How bazifor.me computes a reading — ten claims
method.003.zh: bazifor.me 如何推算解读：十条说明

method.015.en: These are the ten things this site commits to about how its engine works and what it does not do; each can be checked against the rule ids printed in every reading.
method.015.zh: 关于引擎如何运作、不做什么，本站作出以下十条承诺；每一条都能对照每份解读里印有的规则编号来核查。

method.016.en: Every reading is deterministic: the same birth data or floor plan always produces the same result.
method.016.zh: 每份解读的结果都是确定的：同样的出生数据或户型图，永远得出同样的结果。

method.017.en: Every line of output names the classical rule it applies, with a rule id a practitioner can check.
method.017.zh: 输出的每一行都注明所依据的古法规则，并附规则编号，专业人士可以逐条核对。

method.018.en: Birth times are converted to true solar time using the birth city's time zone on that date, its longitude and the equation of time; Singapore and Malaysia clock times before 1982 use the UTC+7:30 offset of that era.
method.018.zh: 出生时间按出生城市当天的时区、经度和均时差换算为真太阳时；新加坡和马来西亚 1982 年前的钟表时间采用当时的 UTC+7:30 时差。

method.019.en: Character strokes for naming follow the Kangxi Dictionary (
method.019.zh: 起名的汉字笔画依据《康熙字典》

method.021.en: The 81-number stroke verdicts use a two-state scale, auspicious or not, until a cited finer table is adopted.
method.021.zh: 81 数理的吉凶判断只分吉与不吉两档，待采用有出处的更细分档表后再调整。

method.022.en: Sound-alike checks run at three strengths: same syllables and tones, same syllables with different tones, and merged consonants; severe words cap the grade.
method.022.zh: 谐音检查分三档强度：音节与声调都相同、音节相同而声调不同、声母合并后相同；出现严重的谐音词时，评级设有上限。

method.023.en: The engine does not predict events; it computes classical structures and states their traditional reading.
method.023.zh: 引擎不预测事件，只推算经典结构，并给出它们的传统解读。

method.024.en: No generative AI writes any reading; the text is rule output and hand-written guides.
method.024.zh: 没有任何一份解读由生成式 AI 撰写，文字都是规则输出和人工撰写的指南。

method.025.en: Workspaces live behind an unguessable link, are never listed, and are not used for anything else.
method.025.zh: 个人空间放在一个猜不到的链接后面，不会被列出，也不作他用。

method.026.en: Where schools disagree on an element or a stroke count, the engine records its choice and marks it as disputed.
method.026.zh: 各流派对某个字的五行归属或笔画数有分歧时，引擎会记下自己的取舍，并标注为有争议。

method.028.zh: 出生时间按经度与均时差换算为真太阳时；1982 年前新加坡和马来西亚的钟表时间采用当时的 UTC+7:30。
